entities.summary: Yahoo! Messenger was an instant messaging client and associated protocol created and formerly operated by Yahoo!. Messenger was provided free of charge and could be downloaded and used with a generic "Yahoo ID", which also allowed access to other Yahoo! services, such as Yahoo! Mail.
